crossRefs.note: “But ask the animals, now, and they will teach you; the birds of the sky, and they will tell you.
Or speak to the earth, and it will teach you. The fish of the sea will declare to you.
For you have hidden their heart from understanding, Therefore you will not exalt them.
But as for you all, come back. I will not find a wise man among you.
I was so senseless and ignorant. I was a brute beast before you.
I said in my heart, “As for the sons of men, God tests them, so that they may see that they themselves are like animals.
In love of the brothers be tenderly affectionate to one another; in honor preferring one another;

translations.web: Why are we counted as animals, which have become unclean in your sight?
translations.bsb: Why are we regarded as cattle, as stupid in your sight?
translations.kjv: Wherefore are we counted as beasts, and reputed vile in your sight?
translations.asv: Wherefore are we counted as beasts, And are become unclean in your sight?
